common.willSync: Saved on this device, will sync
session.wiped: Session wiped for privacy. Photos erased from this device.
error.save: Could not save. It will retry when online.
error.webgl: This device cannot show the color preview
error.webglBody: WebGL2 is needed. Use a recent Safari or Chrome.
splash.promise: Her new cut and color on her own photo in under 2 minutes, with an honest plan for today.
splash.private: All analysis runs on this device. Photos are never uploaded.
splash.customerHint: Customers: open your salon's link or scan its QR code.
splash.inviteHint: Invited by a salon? Open the link from the invite.
login.title: Staff sign in
login.lead: We send a one-tap sign-in link to your email. No password.
login.sentBody: Open the email sent to {email} on this device.
login.emulatorHint: Test mode: the link is in the Emulator UI at localhost:4000 → Authentication.
login.err.auth/invalid-action-code: This link was used or has expired. Send a new one.
login.err.auth/network-request-failed: No connection. Try again when online.
login.privacy: Customers never need an account. Their photos stay on the device.
join.title: Join a salon
join.failedBody: Ask the owner to send the invite again.
join.noInvite: No invite found for {email}. Ask the owner to invite this exact email.
create.title: Create your salon
create.lead: One minute. You can change everything later in Settings.
create.whatsappHint: Used for "Book on WhatsApp" from Try at home.
create.phoneBad: Use an Oman number: +968 and 8 digits.
create.step.catalog: Adding the cut and color catalog
create.noBrands: No dye brands, shade codes, products or prices are added. You add your own through Swatch Scan and Products.
home.lead: See a new cut and color on your own photo, then bring your Look Code to the salon.
home.promise: Your photo stays on your phone.
home.promiseBody: Everything runs on your phone. Only the look choices are saved, never your photo.
home.salonMissingBody: Check the link or ask the salon for a new one.
home.tryOff: This salon has paused Try at home.
home.codeOffline: Connect to the internet to get your code.
home.codeErrorBody: Check the connection and try again.
home.codeHow: The stylist types it, takes fresh photos, and your look loads.
home.codeNoPhoto: The code stores your look choices only. No photo.
home.waText: Hello, I would like to book. My KHUSLA Look Code is {code} ({look}).
code.title: Enter Look Code
code.lead: Type the 6-character code she shows you.
code.offline: Look Code lookup needs a connection.
code.notFoundBody: Check the letters. Codes never use 0, O, 1 or I.
code.expiredBody: Codes last 30 days. Build the look again with her.
capture.title: Photos
capture.note: Take this in a private area. Your photo stays on this device.
capture.privateOn: Private Mode is on: the background is blurred and nothing goes to the gallery.
capture.codeLoaded: Look Code loaded. Take fresh photos and her look will appear.
capture.deniedBody: Allow the camera for this site in the browser settings, or use a photo.
capture.cameraErrorBody: Close other apps using the camera, then try again.
capture.modelsError: Could not load the on-device models
capture.modelsErrorBody: Connect once to download them; after that they work offline.
capture.lessLight: Too bright: step away from direct light
capture.turnLeft: Turn a little to your left
capture.turnRight: Turn a little to your right
capture.cardBody: If a plain white paper is in the photo, tap it. Colors are calibrated to it. Otherwise continue.
capture.cardSet: White card set: colors will be calibrated.
analysis.title: Reading her hair
analysis.onDevice: On this device. Nothing is uploaded.
analysis.noFaceBody: Use a front photo with the face clearly visible.
analysis.failedBody: Retake the photo in better light.
profile.title: Her profile
profile.lead: Every value changes with one tap. Ranges are estimates.
history.title: Hair history
history.lead: Five one-tap questions. They keep today's plan safe.
history.metallicFlag: Metallic-salt strand test required before any chemical service.
history.color: Box dye or salon color in the last 12 months?
history.bleach: Bleach or highlights in the last 12 months?
history.chemical: Keratin, relaxer or perm in the last 6 months?
history.reaction: Ever reacted to hair dye, or scalp sensitive today?
history.reactionNote: Used only now to add "Patch test required". Never saved.
goals.title: Today's goals
looks.title: Looks
looks.emptyBody: Check the catalog: items may be hidden.
looks.stylesAi: Styles change the shape of the hair, so they preview with the AI Final Look.
looks.stylesNoAi: Reference cards. Choose one to add it to the Agreement Card.
block.metallic_positive: Metallic-salt test positive: no chemical service on this hair.
block.henna_lift: Pure henna blocks lightening: results turn copper and unpredictable.
safe.sessions: Needs {n} sessions. Today reaches about level {level}.
safe.henna: Choose a deposit-only shade over henna, or grow it out.
safe.metallic: Treat and grow out; no chemical service today.
color.title: Color Lab
color.canvas: Her photo with the color applied
color.highUpkeep: High upkeep: pastels and vivids need a level 9–10 base and fade fast.
color.startingSwatch: Starting swatch. Scan your own in Swatch Scan for exact color.
color.hijabNote: A soft shayla outline shows which hair stays visible. Covered hair dims.
color.previewNote: Preview. Final shade depends on hair history, brand and processing time.
ladder.title: Level Ladder
lift.naturalTone: Grey coverage: add a natural tone
lift.hennaCopper: Henna under lightener turns copper-orange. A cool blonde is not possible today.
lift.disclaimer: Planning aid only. The colorist decides the formula.
cut.title: Cut Studio
cut.canvas: Her photo with the length tape
cut.tape: Length tape: drag up or down
cut.bigChange: Big change: more than 15 cm shorter. She confirms before the Agreement Card.
cut.noScale: Iris scale not found: lengths are rough.
cut.shrinkNote: After the first visit, use her measured value.
cut.quickNote: On-device preview of the new length. A fully new cut shape needs the AI Final Look.
compare.title: Compare
compare.emptyBody: Add up to 4 looks from Looks or the Color Lab.
ai.title: AI Final Look
ai.consentBody: This one photo will be sent to Cloudflare, outside Oman, to create one image. It is not stored and not used for training.
ai.consent1: Only a head-and-shoulders crop, under 512 px, background blurred.
ai.consent2: You will be asked again for every image.
ai.consent3: The result is labeled "AI preview" and is not saved.
ai.cap: Today's AI previews are used up. Color preview still works. Resets at 4:00 AM.
ai.off: AI Final Look is off for this salon.
ai.error: The AI preview did not work
ai.errorBody: Check the connection. The on-device preview still works.
ai.label: AI preview
ai.caption: AI preview of {look}. Real results depend on her hair.
ai.notSaved: Not saved anywhere unless she chooses to share it.
agreement.title: Agreement Card
agreement.footer: Lengths ≈ ±5 to 8% (iris-based). Colors are previews; results depend on hair history and tests.
agreement.noProducts: No services yet. Add them in Products & services.
agreement.addPhoto: Add her photo to the card
agreement.approved: Approved by both. The service can start.
agreement.blocked: This plan cannot be done today
agreement.bigCm: The new length is {cm} shorter. Is she sure?
agreement.bigLevels: This is {n} levels lighter. Is she sure?
done.title: Done
done.rating: How did she feel about the result?
done.waNote: WhatsApp opens with the text; nothing is sent automatically.
done.reminder: {salon}: Hello {name}, your next visit is in about {weeks} weeks. Reply to book.
done.saveProfile: She agrees to save her hair profile (labels only)
done.saveProfileNote: Face shape, skin tone, levels and history labels. Never photos or health answers.
done.wipeNote: "Next client" erases every photo from this device.
dash.title: Today
dash.liveNote: Live: updates as stylists approve cards on any device.
catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.noSwatchesBody: Scan your swatch ring in Swatch Scan first.
swatch.title: Swatch Scan
swatch.lead: Photograph your own swatch ring next to a white card. KHUSLA measures each swatch so previews use the dyes you actually own. No brand is preloaded.
swatch.noLinesBody: Type the name of a dye line you use, then scan its swatches.
swatch.importNote: Columns: line, code, level, tone. The scan fills the measured color later.
swatch.step1: Lay the swatches on a plain surface with a white card in frame.
swatch.step2: Use daylight or your salon light.
swatch.step3: Tap the white card, then tap each swatch and type your code.
swatch.tapSwatch: Tap a swatch to measure it
swatch.linkHint: Link catalog shades to these swatches in Catalog → Shades.
swatch.codeHint: Exactly as written on your swatch.
swatch.existing: This code exists: saving re-scans it.
swatch.repeatTarget: Re-scan under the same light: ΔE ≤ 2
products.title: Products & services
products.lead: Your own list and prices (OMR, 3 decimals). Used for the price on the Agreement Card.
products.emptyBody: Add your services, or import a CSV.
products.importNote: Columns: name, nameAr, category, priceOmr, active. UTF-8 with or without BOM.
clients.importNote: Columns: displayName, phone (+968 and 8 digits). Duplicates are skipped and listed.
csv.err.name: Name missing
staff.title: Staff
staff.inviteHow: She opens the link, signs in with this email, and joins.
settings.title: Settings
settings.privateMode: Private Mode (background blur, no thumbnails, idle wipe)
settings.privacyNote: Photos are never stored in the cloud. Only labels and agreements are saved.
settings.aiNote: Free tier: about 80 previews a day for the whole account. Consent is asked for every image.
settings.growthNote: After two visits KHUSLA learns each client's own rate.
settings.demoNote: Removes the 3 demo clients and their consultations.
reports.title: Reports
reports.footer: KHUSLA · Day boundaries in Asia/Muscat · Generated on the device
reports.csvNote: UTF-8 with BOM, opens in Excel with Arabic intact.
